_comment: Mirrors the schema's own hierarchy. 'Portfolio' points at /projects because an initiative is the container and a tool belongs to one — the homepage leads with initiatives for the same reason. 'Our work' carries the two discovery facets (impact area, country) that cut across both. Labels use the database's vocabulary — impact area, initiative, tool, outcome — so a word means the same thing in Airtable, in the URL and on the page. 'Tools' rather than 'Products': nothing here is for sale. No nav link points at a single record; those pages exist only while the record is Live.
